elevation_map — DRIVE walkterrain op

• Data kinds: points → depth

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.elevation_map(points, cell: 'float' = 0.05, agg: 'str' = 'max', bounds=None) (to call the implementation directly, import terrain; terrain.elevation_map(points, cell: 'float' = 0.05, agg: 'str' = 'max', bounds=None); from the registry, opsdrive.get("elevation_map"))

• Return value through the ledger: fullseye.ledger.elevation_map(...) returns only the declared out type depth (the underlying function also returns auxiliary values). When you need what was dropped, use fullseye.ledger.elevation_map.raw(...) or call terrain.elevation_map directly.

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Bin a point cloud into a 2.5-D elevation grid.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Parameters

points : (N, 3) array of (x, y, z), z = height.

cell : grid resolution in world units.

agg : 'max' (canopy / obstacle-safe, default), 'min' (ground), or 'mean'.

bounds : optional (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax); defaults to the data extent.

Returns (grid, extent) where grid[i, j] is the aggregated height of cell (row i = y, col j = x) and empty cells are nan. extent is (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax).

空の入力(points が 0 要素)は bounds があれば全セル nan の格子を返す(理由: 観測の無い範囲は nan = 観測していない。bounds が無ければ範囲が決まらないので ValueError)。An empty cloud with bounds gives an all-nan grid; without bounds it raises ValueError (no extent).
